case_title.quote: OM PRAKASH v. STATE OF HARYANA
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.quote: Om Prakash, Kartar Singh and Chhoti
number_of_accused.reason: Three accused whose convictions the Court decided.

accused_gender.reason: Two male accused and one female accused (Chhoti), so Mixed is supported.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for any accused.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No wealth, poverty or class of the accused is described.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: The victim is a female prosecutrix.

victim_age.quote: date of birth of the victim was 10.1.1980 which means that in June, 1995, she was only 15 years old
victim_age.reason: Age of 15 is stated and supported by the school certificate.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prior enmity/dispute (alleged by defence): Kartar Singh claimed the victim suspected him of spreading news of her abortion
accused_victim_relationship.quote: suspected that it was he (Kartar Singh) who spread the news in the village about the abortion
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The judgment describes an alleged enmity dispute, which the 'Not stated' value overlooks.

offence_category.reason: The offence is rape under IPC s.376(2)(g).

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.376(2)(g); s.109 read with s.107; charge-sheet also cited s.342 and s.506 read with s.34
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits ss.342 and 506 r/w s.34 from the charge-sheet, though the framed charges were 376 and 109.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned in the judgment.

evidence_type.reason: Victim testimony, mother's corroboration, medical, radiological and school evidence are all described.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by an accused is recorded.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: threatened to be eliminated if she disclosed about the incident to any one
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Minority, detention for an hour, threats and joint commission are all noted in the facts.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted by the Court.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced each one of the accused Om Prakash and Kartar Singh to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court's convictions, sentences and fines.

high_court_outcome.quote: conviction and sentence recorded against accused/appellants ... are affirmed
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeal on 30.7.2008, affirming conviction and sentence.

final_outcome.quote: all the three appeals are dismissed
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed all appeals, upholding convictions.

offence_finally_established.quote: Consequent upon the dismissal of their appeals
offence_finally_established.reason: Convictions under s.376(2)(g) and s.109 stand, as stated.

imprisonment_type.quote: rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years

imprisonment_years.quote: rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years
imprisonment_years.reason: Ten years for the main accused, upheld by the Supreme Court.

fine_rs.reason: Rs.10,000 fine for the main accused is stated.

neutral_facts.correct_value: The victim was lured by one accused to fetch lassi from that accused's own house, where her husband and another man were, and the door was bolted.
neutral_facts.quote: accused Chhoti came there and asked the prosecutrix to bring 'lassi' from her house
neutral_facts.reason: Garbles whose house the lassi was to be fetched from and who made the request; otherwise factually grounded and neutral.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment for s.376(2)(g).

attempt_completion.quote: the prosecutrix was raped by them
attempt_completion.reason: The rape is described as completed.

physical_harm.correct_value: No external injuries; no injury over perineum or thighs; hymen of healed ruptured type admitting one finger easily
physical_harm.quote: Hymen was of healed ruptured type and admitted one finger easily.
physical_harm.reason: Medical findings are correct, but the judgment does not expressly say the medical exam confirmed sexual assault.

number_of_offences.quote: trial court framed charge for the offence punishable under Section 376 IPC ... Section 109 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Two framed charges (s.376 and s.109), both upheld for the relevant accused.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is described.

premeditation_planning.reason: No express finding of premeditation is made by the Court.

motive.correct_value: alleged: enmity (defence claimed Kartar Singh was falsely implicated over suspicion of spreading news of the victim's abortion)
motive.quote: suspected that it was he (Kartar Singh) who spread the news in the village about the abortion, and due to that reason, he was falsely implicated
motive.reason: An alleged motive of enmity is stated by the defence, so 'Not identified' is incomplete.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the evidence adduced by the victim is natural and trustworthy
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Victim, mother, radiological, school, and medical evidence are relied on as stated.

witness_credibility.quote: Both the witnesses have been subjected to lengthy cross-examination but nothing has come out to create reasonable doubt
witness_credibility.reason: Court found victim and mother credible and not falsely implicating.

post_offence_conduct.quote: who threatened her of dire consequences before she was freed
post_offence_conduct.reason: Threats and the resulting 20-day non-disclosure are recorded.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated.

bail_history.quote: granted bail by this Court vide orders dated 18.5.2009, 20.7.2009 and 16.4.2010
bail_history.reason: Supreme Court bail dates for all three accused are given.

trial_duration.quote: order dated 16.12.1996 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge
trial_duration.reason: Dates for trial judgment, High Court and Supreme Court match; offence date not given.

legal_representation.quote: Rishi Malhotra, Prem Malhotra for the Appellant. Nupur Chaudhary, Vivekta Singh, Kamal Mohan Gupta for the Respondent

investigation_status.quote: charge-sheet was submitted by the police before the Magistrate
investigation_status.reason: FIR, spot inspection, s.164 statement, medical tests and charge-sheet are all recorded.

procedural_irregularity.quote: there is sufficient explanation on record for the same
procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse is recorded; the FIR delay was explained.

appeal_history.quote: all the three appeals are dismissed
appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court dismissal and Supreme Court dismissal are all accurately reported.

prosecution_argument.reason: The State's submissions are not summarised in the judgment.

defence_argument.quote: sentence awarded against accused Chhoti be reduced to the period already undergone by her
defence_argument.reason: Gender-based and abetment arguments and sentence reduction plea are all recorded.

legal_principle_applied.quote: Intentional aiding of the offence is covered by the third clause mentioned in Section 107 IPC.
legal_principle_applied.reason: Section 107 third clause and aiding-at-the-time principle are applied as described.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Kulwant Singh @ Kulbansh Singh vs. State of Bihar (2007) 15 SCC 670 and Priya Patel vs. State of M.P. (2006) 6 SCC 263 - referred to
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Precedents and citations match, including Joseph Kurian as quoted.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the sentence awarded by the trial court as upheld by the High Court, is just and proper
sentencing_rationale.reason: The Court found the upheld sentence just and proper without reduction.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The Court did not separately weigh aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.quote: shall be taken into custody forthwith to serve out the remaining of their sentence
other_sentence_order.reason: Custody direction to serve the remaining sentence is recorded.
